data.why: STIX counts come from multi-HDU FITS (astropy.io.fits, binary table with units/header keywords) and RPW PSDs from CDF (cdflib); both must be built with that library's binary writer, not plain text, so a correct fixture can't be produced here without running code. The repo ships no example files, and neither format is in the provided stock list, so no upload fixture is included.

goals: Import a STIX X-ray spectrogram for a flare interval and inspect the counts/energy spectrogram
Subtract a quiet-time or background-file baseline from STIX counts per energy channel
Import RPW HFR/TNR radio data and filter polluted frequencies to see a clean Type III burst
Load EPD energetic-particle flux for the same day and background-subtract it per energy channel
Stack STIX, RPW, and EPD panels into one combined plot on a shared time axis to trace particle acceleration/transport timing
Save the session's loaded instruments to a Data Pack file and reload it later without re-importing

review.summary: The tree states SoloLab's purpose correctly: correlating STIX, RPW and EPD on a shared time axis. Its evidence is honest and every screen I opened matches its node, even though the sandbox blocked all data loading. It leaves out the background-subtraction stage the README treats as core, plus file upload and Data Pack save/reload, and one feature (f1) overclaims, so it needs those fixes before filing.
